answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a fingerprint of its model weights: at enrolment it publishes a hash of its weights, and each epoch it must answer a probe only that exact model can produce quickly. Like saffron grown in one grove, each fingerprint is unique to its soil, so a thousand fakes cloned from one model share one fingerprint across the whole horizon and earn a single reward, while an honest agent trains once.
